prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: one original transparent rendered product mark for Ferrugo, usable as a favicon at 32, 48 and 64 pixels.
Image 1 is the new Ferrugo Bounded document preview aperture, a SEMANTIC and material reference. Image 2 is the existing Ferromark mark and Image 3 the existing Ferroni mark: exact FAMILY ICON STYLE references for metal, graphite contour, restrained oxide, lighting and visual weight. Do not copy their product silhouettes. The marks are rendered material pictures, not vector line icons.

Design the deliberately simplified mark described here:
One satin-steel document leaf nested inside a smaller bold graphite rectangular aperture, with a short oxide corner stop at the lower right. The leaf carries only two broad document strokes. Three major shapes, clearly a bounded document preview at 32px. Do not draw a literal camera, lens or browser window.

It must express a pdf preview renderer and be derived from the logic of its hero instrument, without miniaturizing the whole machine. Make a compact, distinctive, balanced silhouette that reads clearly on warm white at 32px. Front-facing or extremely shallow three-quarter view, broad solid satin-steel faces, dark warm graphite sides and edge contrast, a restrained rust-brown oxide component. Match the references' quiet warm studio light and shallow material depth. Keep negative gaps generous enough to survive downsampling. No tiny fasteners, grain that hides the silhouette, ruler ticks, captions, product-name lettering, initials-as-wordmarks, extra decoration, cartoon mascot or app tile backdrop. The letter-like glyph in the Ferrolex tile, if requested, is an intentional broad structural part of that mark.

Output a single centered square master with 8–10% clear padding around the complete shape, no clipping. Genuine transparent background and transparent internal negative spaces. No opaque white, grey or black background, checkerboard, floating shadow plate, framing badge, website, presentation board or multi-size contact sheet. Preserve the original rendered steel/oxide appearance; no glow, neon, dirty rust or dark-theme scene.
derivation: Measure content bounds at alpha >= 10%; crop only the master padding; center at 87.5% square; Lanczos resize. The threshold is used only for measuring bounds, never on the exported color pixels. No redraw or material edit.
